legend.OBSERVED: A fact read from your own public record, such as your Conexus Indiana case study.
legend.BENCHMARK: A published public series, named and dated beside the number.
legend.ASSUMED: Our estimate, stated as a range. These are the numbers we are asking you to correct.

book.heading: Fifteen minutes, your numbers against ours
book.body: Bring the figures you know and we will re-run the model with you on the call. If our baseline is wrong, that is the most useful thing you can tell us.

closing: If the answer is no, that is a fair answer, and the model is yours to keep either way.
